narrative_note: Subarea covers Dalarna county but extends slightly outside the county borders via a line corridor going east into Uppsala and Gävleborg counties. Regional grid is a meshed 130 kV grid with an underlying 50 kV grid. In the remaining municipalities (outside Gagnef/Mora/Orsa/Vansbro/Älvdalen/parts of Ludvika), other DSOs own the local grid and connect to Ellevio's regional grid at interconnection points. Those municipalities are not explicitly listed in the source.
